versions.changelog: Major all-round upgrade: catalog-aware smart-add preserves native Bring icons and localized names; stdin batch imports support recipes and automation; --dry-run now previews every modifying command; human-readable list output maps internal catalog IDs; documentation now clearly explains the full lifecycle, private terminal-only login, owner-only token storage, minimal curl+jq runtime, and official Bring-only network access.
Security cleanup: removed persisted email data, purge legacy email/password profile fields, fixed unsafe help example, and clarified the public Bring app client identifier.

Security hardening: passwords are no longer stored or accepted in chat; profile and token writes are private and atomic; sensitive curl data avoids process arguments; removed unreachable list-creation code.

Replaced the example password placeholder ('secret') with an obvious non-secret placeholder so static secret-scanning stops flagging it. Includes the security-review wording fixes: terminal-first credential entry, explicit warning that the chat option puts credentials in chat history, documented local storage of password+token and network scope (api.getbring.com only). No script/behavior changes.

Security review fixes: terminal credential entry is now the recommended default; explicit warning that the chat option puts credentials in chat history/logs. Documented exactly what is stored (password + token) and that it grants ongoing account access; declared network scope (api.getbring.com only) + data handling. Removed the contradictory 'credentials never leave your machine' wording. No script/behavior changes.
Security fix: replaced unsafe cat<<EOF credential writing with jq --arg for proper JSON escaping (prevents injection). Improved urlencode sed fallback coverage.
Improved description: better agent triggers, search keywords, privacy note
README: removed misleading 'zero dependencies' claim, added privacy-first credential setup docs.

Privacy-first credential setup: agent now asks whether to share credentials in chat or enter privately via terminal. Fixed urlencode() to prefer jq (documented dep) over python3. Updated description to highlight privacy feature.
Improved description: highlights security scan results, zero dependencies, and guided agent setup.
Rewritten README with clearer feature comparison and plain language.
Better documentation: Agent Setup Guide now covers no-lists scenario, dedicated section explaining lists must be created/deleted in app (API limitation).
Removed create-list (Bring API accepts request but lists don't appear in app). Filter null/ghost lists from output. Lists must be created/deleted in the Bring app.
Added create-list command with themed icons (grocery, home, work, school, trip, party, baby, pet, christmas, easter). Note: list deletion is not supported by the Bring API.
Initial release — zero-dependency Bring! integration with full CRUD, batch operations, default list support, and agent setup guide. Only requires curl + jq.
